proposition: Melvin-Koushki dates the writing of Żawʾ al-Lamaʿāt to the year 815 (1412), presumably in Isfahan, with no colophon cited and no asterisk; the Majlis copy (8 Dhū l-Qaʿda 828/21 September 1425) is a later copy, and a copy made in Turkey in 833/1429 is the earliest other dated one.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue

mediation.note: basis of 815 not given in the entry; place presumed
